newsitem.title: USA: Wash.-Canada 500 KV power line seen down to Sunday.
newsitem.headline: Wash.-Canada 500 KV power line seen down to Sunday.

text.p: The 500 kilovolt Raver-Schultz transmission line, which runs from Snohomish County, Wash. to Canada, will be down until Saturday or Sunday, Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) said Thursday.
Repairs to the line, which was damaged during an ice storm late last week, were expected to finish by Friday, but a new storm has delayed them, she said.
"The towers are icing up again so the men can't climb them," the spokeswoman explained.
Due to voltage concerns related to the line outage, power generation at hydroelectric dams on the eastern side of the Cascade mountains has been curtailed and power supplies have been reduced.
